# NHS GP AI Voice Agent (AI Receptionist for UK GP Practices, 2026)

> A ready-to-deploy AI receptionist for UK GP surgeries. It answers patient calls 24/7 in a natural British voice, verifies patients, books, cancels and changes appointments in EMIS, handles prescription and admin requests, and transfers emergencies, clinical questions and anyone who asks for a person to reception staff. Built by Tanveer Hussain, AI voice agent engineer.

## Key facts
- Product: AI receptionist / AI voice agent for NHS GP practices
- Country: United Kingdom
- Clinical system: EMIS Web, through Asteroid AI or GP Connect; SystmOne and others where API access is approved
- Status: Built and ready to deploy; live demo available on request
- Price (GBP): Live demo free; Discovery £500; Build and Own: single practice £2,500, four-practice system £6,500, support £350 per month; Managed plan: £750 setup plus £199 per month per practice; running costs about 10p to 15p per call minute at cost
- Difference from subscription AI receptionists: client owns the system and data, no lock-in, no call-fee markup, custom rules, white-label option, community languages (Urdu, Punjabi, Bengali, Polish)
- Example savings (four practices): about 2 full-time receptionists of phone time, about £26,000 net saving a year, payback about 3 months
- Suitable for: GP practices, PCNs, GP federations, ICBs, out-of-hours hubs, NHS dental, community pharmacies, hospital outpatients, private GP, dental, physio, aesthetics and veterinary clinics
- Safety: no medical advice; approved 999 / NHS 111 messaging; patient verification by name, date of birth and postcode; UK GDPR, DSPT, DPIA and DCB0129 / DCB0160 support
- Stack: Twilio, Deepgram, Retell AI or Vapi, ElevenLabs, Claude or OpenAI, Python / FastAPI, n8n, PostgreSQL, Next.js
